items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 after hip/groin issue; expected to play vs Eagles with possible snap limits per speculation.
items.why: Returned to practice, McVay expects play; ETR Sunday list.
items.implication: WR1 start with volume risk if limited; boosts Stafford/Adams slightly less.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets return after two missed games.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring; excellent matchup vs Cowboys.
items.why: ETR Sunday IN list after missing time.
items.implication: Elite WR1/2 play; Texans implied high points.
items.opportunity: Full target share return in high DvP.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday vs Rams due to hamstring.
items.implication: Eagles pass game depleted with Goedert also out.
items.opportunity: Targets to Wicks/others; Hurts rushing upside?

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to sprained ankle.
items.implication: Major WR1 void; Addison primary beneficiary.

items.text: Colts downgraded WR Keenan Allen to OUT for Sunday in London vs Commanders due to groin; elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine.
Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back but speculation on limited snaps; monitor for full role vs Eagles.
items.why: Hip recovery progress but explosiveness concerns earlier.
items.implication: Start but fade pure volume plays if limited; Adams may retain some targets.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return; Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL, Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.opportunity: High target volume vs soft secondary.

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson OUT creates opportunity vs soft secondary.
items.implication: Strong WR2/flex start with elevated targets.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Without three of most important players vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.implication: Fade Eagles pass catchers/Hurts volume; boost Rams defense/Adams/Nacua.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, hurt chest, Charbonnet back at practice. Still eye test positive long-term.
items.implication: Avoid short-term; stash for ROS if talent holds.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ yards to RB every game. Top 10 play.
items.why: Workhorse role + matchup with Dowdle OUT again.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love LOVE: RB5 utilization, 26 touches last week > W1+2 combined; NYG allow 5.1 YPC (3rd most), double-digit target share every game.
Omarion Hampton HATE: RB27 util, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps to 42% W3, 13% 3rd down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd fewest).
items.implication: Sit/fade even if rostered; committee risk.
items.opportunity: Declining snaps/routes/targets vs elite run D.
